folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B210, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
D1–D11, the three adapter descriptions, private structural comparisons and P1–P4 were read in full. The useful finding is selective mechanism adaptation: metadata accepted by a compiler can still have no executing consumer, and a source-tree foundation can be present while a distinct authoring adapter is absent. Neither pathname presence nor successful compilation establishes held-source/counter/discovery gates. A changed pack retaining the same schema/revision still has different content identity; do not union same-ID commands, start effects or physical dependencies blindly. Preserve the original Pro baseline and archived alternatives as history. These are historical observations at the recorded input, not a fresh current-source absence finding (AD32/AD36).

The life adapter’s attempted rollback could itself throw; archive-write followed by active-save removal was not atomic publication. Keep optional true death distinct from defeat and world-dependent continuation, and preserve original bytes through supported transition failure. Discovery, phase and actual physical consequences of outings remain useful without mandatory lethal choices or a universal one-attempt limit. Per-occurrence settlement identity differs from a prohibition on another attempt (AD22).

P1–P4 are historical proposals, not current assignments, commits or reservations. Their 1366×768 primary target, mandatory separate worktree, per-lane full suite and final human acceptance wording must be read through current desktop targets, AD41, AD36 and AD42. Use current viewport and prose-first task composition where selected; retain functional home mechanisms without restarting the stopped pictured-home experiment. The 64 focused SOURCE tests and no-build/no-browser/no-save limits stay exact. B210 reopened no private pack or archived source and establishes no current port completion.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B210, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
All 47 requested original rows, N01–N30 and every prepared packet were read. Preserve the difference between metadata with no additional mechanism and real native equivalents worth verifying/reusing. The five surviving defect rejections concern lost saves, phantom work, accidental RNG bias and duplicate/render/restore/timer side effects; R21’s native capped curve was not authority to reject other world-specific progression. Repeatable activity remains compatible with idempotent settlement of each occurrence, finite real stock and stable copies (AD22/AD32).

Two original routing slips need explicit qualification: R60 names P06 in its prose although its Packet column and P16 body own the training ladder; P06 owns the battle extension points. R68 points hidden-tab progression to N28, while N28 is slots/backups and N29 is hidden-tab intervals. Retain these original rows as history and follow P16/P06 and N29 respectively. R24 spoilage still needs lossless lot acquire/split/merge/storage/import, not an age field on a singleton template. N18 was dormant source ecology, not running offline simulation; its zero-population and causal price/gathering trigger remains useful. N28 and N29 need distinct lock/backup/undo and active-branch interval contracts, not a blanket claim that prepaid backlog proves catch-up.

Preserve per-copy growing gear versus pooled template bonuses, collection versus expenditure, observed drop versus global item knowledge, actual recipe learning versus a readiness panel, cause-aware defeat records versus mortal death, and carried presentation settings versus established local preference. A related-skill dependency need not be globally acyclic; prevent recursive awards through a sound mechanism rather than banning every valid feedback graph. AD52/ACR permit activity compression while retaining long play and concurrent supported activity. Palette numbers, comfort switches and packet order are proposals, not universal world laws.

The prepared packets grant no current launch, writer reservation, commit or port. Replace their old 1366-primary, compulsory worktree, per-worker full suite and human-blocking wording with current viewport/AD41/AD36/AD42 when a task is actually selected. No original HTML, mod checkout, source tree, JSON ledger or runtime path was reverified here. The report’s documented source sweep was structural plus selected bodies, not another literal full primary-source read; B210 does not expand that evidence.
